There are no contemporary memorials in their original form, no edicts to check against, and no account from Hongzhang (the record gives only this name), Pasha, the Russian side, or Chong Hou to set against it.

S-QSG412.title: 趙爾巽等《清史稿·左宗棠傳》（1928，维基文库本）

episode.outcome: The argument over halting the western expedition ends with the court deciding to march beyond the pass. North and south Xinjiang are recovered. After the Chong Hou treaty is renegotiated and Zuo moves out to Hami, Russia returns Ili in the first month of the following year and the coastal forces stand down.
episode.quote: 明年正月，和議成，交還伊犁，防海軍皆罷。

episode.outcome: Zuo's own ending after his recall: he has an audience, is made a Grand Council minister and also serves at the foreign office. His colleagues find him hard to bear and he resents serving inside, so he pleads illness and asks to retire.
episode.quote: 然值軍機、譯署，同列頗厭苦之。宗棠亦自不樂居內，引疾乞退。

additions.why: This is the gap between E15 and E17. It gives the three-route deployment and the 40,000-plus troops behind 'Russia heard the imperial army was moving in force'. That troop strength is the concrete basis for the claim that Russia was cowed.

This is the gap between E21 and E22. It shows what 'summoned to the capital as an adviser' actually led to: Zuo became a Grand Council minister and also served at the foreign office. It continues the plot of analysis.2.

This immediately follows E23. The biography sums up the episode as evidence of his prestige, then turns: his colleagues found him hard to bear and he asked to retire. It is the ending of the 'entered the capital' episode.

context_issues.problem: The paragraph jumps from 'Zuo asked to move out to Hami' straight to 'carrying his coffin'. It leaves out the three-route deployment and the 40,000-plus troops. Readers cannot see what concrete force made Russia 'cowed by our military prestige'.

context_issues.problem: The paragraph stops at 'the talk stopped'. It misses the biography's immediate turn: after his recall Zuo became a Grand Council minister, his colleagues found him hard to bear, and he asked to retire. The episode reads as pure prestige, but the source pairs the prestige with friction at court.

quote.quote: 然值軍機、譯署，同列頗厭苦之。宗棠亦自不樂居內，引疾乞退。

context_issues.problem: The draft frames everything as a ledger, yet it leaves out the funding source given in the same evidence (E19). Zuo asked to borrow from abroad, Shen Baozhen opposed it, and the edict allocated 5 million and authorized another 5 million in foreign loans. Without this, 'the biography credits the abundance of supply' hides that the supply depended on foreign debt.

quote.quote: 為撥款五百萬，敕自借外國債五百萬。

context_issues.problem: Both language versions state that the source gives only the name Hongzhang. The biography names Li Hongzhang in full more than once, which misleads readers about how complete the source is.

quote.quote: 七月，李鴻章江蘇軍入浙攻嘉善

review.overall: The source is complete and the main storyline of the draft is accurate; the ending (Ili returned) is already in the evidence. Required fixes: the repeated statement that the source gives only the name Hongzhang (it gives Li Hongzhang in full), and the claim that the biography only records events, which ignores the closing verdict. Optionally add the troop deployment and Zuo's request to retire after entering the Grand Council.
